summary: Full resolution of residual findings R1-R2 from DRIVE_01_F02_REVIEW.md across comprehensive channel operation tracking, non-blocking caller close under saturated cleanup pool (R1), and exact process creation identity with live invocation matching and fail-closed enforcement (R2). Verified by automated test suites (123 Maven, 77 PowerShell, 5 repro detectors) and fresh-root browser walkthrough exit 0.

R1_channelOperationOwnershipAndCleanupAd.finding: Non-read IO timeout (position, size) was not counted in activeWorkerReads; close() fell back to synchronous delegate.close() on caller thread when worker pool was full. Caller-side AutoCloseable disposal could block caller on kernel locks.
R1_channelOperationOwnershipAndCleanupAd.resolution: Replaced activeWorkerReads with activeWorkerOperations tracking all delegate operations (read, position, size). Non-blocking close immediately exits caller (<1ms) and delegates physical close to in-flight worker or dedicated bounded cleanupExecutor without synchronous caller fallback. Caller-side synchronous disposal on timeout/interruption eliminated.
R1_channelOperationOwnershipAndCleanupAd.tests: DriveMetadataCleanupLifecycleTest (6/6 PASS), DriveCleanupAdmissionRaceTest (8/8 PASS), reviewer repro DRIVE_F02_position_close.java (callerStillBlockedInClose=false ioWorkers=1), reviewer repro DRIVE_F01_channel_close.java (callerStillBlockedInClose=false), reviewer repro DRIVE_F01_late_open.java (lateOpenChannelStillOpen=false actualWorkers=0)

R2_exactIdentityAndTrustworthyInvocation.finding: stop_drive.ps1 accepted start-time difference below 500ms (failing to catch 200ms mismatch in reviewer repro). State schema fields were required to be present but were not checked against the live process invocation CommandLine.
R2_exactIdentityAndTrustworthyInvocation.resolution: Enforced exact process creation identity (<1ms delta). Added live invocation verification querying live CommandLine via CIM/WMI to verify presence of mount subcommand, remoteTarget, and mountPoint. Unreadable or mismatched live invocation fails closed (VERIFICATION_FAILED / IDENTITY_MISMATCH), preserves state file, and never signals process. Synchronized policy to status_drive.ps1 and mount_drive.ps1 launch-cleanup.
R2_exactIdentityAndTrustworthyInvocation.tests: test_drive_security_seams.ps1 (35/35 PASS, including TC-R2-01 to TC-R2-05), reviewer repro DRIVE_F02_stop_reused_identity.ps1 (terminationRequestedDespiteCreationAndInvocationMismatch=False across PS 5.1 and PS 7), reviewer repro DRIVE_F01_stop_missing_identity.ps1 (terminationRequestedWithMissingIdentityFields=False across PS 5.1 and PS 7)
